title: Lolawang factory-waste management blockade

notes: About 200 residents returned after initial 30-person gathering. 1700 employees unable to enter factory are not protesting turnout. Police dispersal does not change private target.

notes: Reported alongside the opposing anti-Otsus group. Around 70 is the combined count and cannot be assigned to either group. Reopen if a separate state-directed demand is documented.

title: Sangkanjaya farmers seek local subsidized fertilizer outlet
reason: The Pantura Post article explicitly reports approximately 30 farmers who came to the village hall, below the 50-person threshold.
notes: Preserved from the candidate list under the same E004 ID after the coordinator's independent selected-body reading of S061. Village head Jelani actually met the farmers and said he would convey their demands to the regent through the subdistrict; this supports government accommodation for the excluded action. The 74 and 49 membership figures are not assembly attendance. The worker's earlier limited extraction recovered only the broader dozens description and missed the explicit attendance sentence.
